project_name: SecurePath Cyber Ltd. Marketing & Advisory Website
design_direction: Minimal, modern, calm confidence — minimalist editorial, generous white space, large confident type, thin 1px hairline dividers, premium advisory firm feel. NOT dark hacker/matrix cyber look.
theme: Light & Dark Dual Harmony (Light editorial canvas with Deep Navy focal sections)

signature_motif.name: THE PATH
signature_motif.description: One continuous thin teal (#0D9488) SVG path that draws itself progressively using Framer Motion (useScroll + useSpring) as the user scrolls down the page. The path travels up-and-right between sections and terminates in a refined SVG arrowhead at the final CTA section.
signature_motif.implementation: SVG overlay canvas with fixed or relative scroll-synced path coordinates, strokeDasharray/strokeDashoffset or pathLength animation, 1.5px stroke width, stroke-linecap round.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid protocol (Mode A for Marketing). 12-column grid layout with 1px hairline borders (`border-[#D0D8E4]`/`border-slate-200`) and generous internal padding (`p-8` or `p-12`).
layout_and_spacing.section_padding: py-20 lg:py-32 px-4 sm:px-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.dividers: 1px hairline borders (`border-[#D0D8E4]`/`border-slate-200/80`). Avoid thick dividers or drop shadows on static elements.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Flat surfaces by default. Subtle diffuse ambient elevation only on hover (`hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-navy-900/5 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300`).

sections_breakdown.name: Header & Sticky Navigation
sections_breakdown.description: Sticky top bar with smooth state transition from transparent on top hero to solid white/glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200/80) on scroll.

motion_and_micro_interactions.viewport_trigger: reveal once at 20% in view (amount: 0.2, once: true)
effects: Word-by-word mask reveal on hero title
StrokeDashoffset path drawing on SVG scroll path and shield outline
Magnetic CTA button cursor response (using spring physics)
Blur-to-sharp scroll reveals (filter: blur(8px) -> blur(0px) + opacity 0 -> 1)
Card hover subtle lift (-translate-y-1 + soft ambient shadow)

accessibility_wcag_aa.contrast_ratios: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text (#475569 on white/steel), 7:1 for headings (#0B2545), 3:1 for teal accents (#0D9488)
accessibility_wcag_aa.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. When active, replace path drawing and magnetic effects with immediate opacity fades
accessibility_wcag_aa.focus_states: Explicit ring-2 ring-[#0D9488] ring-offset-2 on all interactive controls
accessibility_wcag_aa.data_testids: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='nav-book-consultation-btn', data-testid='booking-modal-submit-btn', data-testid='bento-service-card-iso27001')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure Google Fonts link for 'Outfit' and 'Inter' is added in public/index.html or imported in index.css.
2. Configure tailwind.config.js to extend colors with exact hex codes: primary deep_navy (#0B2545), teal (#0D9488), cyber_blue (#1565C0), steel_bg (#F0F4F8), etc.
3. Implement the signature 'THE PATH' SVG component using Framer Motion's useScroll and useSpring hooks to animate strokeDashoffset / pathLength along the page as the user scrolls.
4. All code files MUST be in React JavaScript (.js / .jsx). Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
5. Every single button, link, accordion header, input, and modal close control MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
6. Front-end form submission in the Booking Modal MUST prevent default submission and render a clean, animated success state card with a checkmark.
7. Build sub-routes using React Router (/services, /about, /privacy) while maintaining full access to the interactive home page flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid standard AI slop aesthetics (no generic blue tech gradients or hacker matrix looks). Stick strictly to the minimal, modern, calm confidence editorial aesthetic.
Ensure generous spacing: use py-20 lg:py-32 for sections and p-8 or p-12 inside bento grid cards.
Do NOT use complete transparent background on sticky header or modals; always use backdrop-blur-md with semi-opaque backgrounds (e.g. bg-white/90 or bg-[#0B2545]/95).
Ensure contrast meets APCA / WCAG AA standards across all text and buttons.
Always test interactive states for keyboard navigation and screen readers.
